cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When you thank the festival team, say I repaired the stage in the rain. Remember our speech practice: tell them what somebody did, not just that they were wonderful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A generous opening; you used to forget half the team. Now give me one equal sentence about replacing those rotten boards.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want your name in the speech?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With the work beside it: I replaced the boards so the dancers could perform. Read that bit to me; you know how I used to make you keep the verb.

reason: Make prior instruction affect the present exact Drive, and give each A turn a needed response from B. State incompatibility and disadvantage concretely; keep deliberate character concealment distinct from missing author context.
